facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 64°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Mud Ridge (4,070 ft) and Mt Hood Test Site (5,380 ft) 34 to 37 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Mud Ridge
evidence.detail: left April 19; earlier seasons: May 27 (2023), May 26 (2024), May 7 (2025)

evidence.name: Mt Hood Test Site
evidence.detail: left May 20; earlier seasons: June 22 (2023), June 28 (2024), June 23 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Mud Ridge (4,070 ft) and Mt Hood Test Site (5,380 ft).

evidence.name: Mud Ridge
evidence.detail: 6.3 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 37.0 in (2023), 27.4 in (2024), 22.8 in (2025)

evidence.name: Mt Hood Test Site
evidence.detail: 21.7 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 62.3 in (2023), 51.5 in (2024), 57.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 26 and May 19, carried from the melt-out dates at Mud Ridge (4,070 ft) and Mt Hood Test Site (5,380 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Mud Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out April 19, at the pass elevation; points to March 27 to May 10

evidence.name: Mt Hood Test Site
evidence.detail: melted out May 20, 1,351 ft above the pass; points to March 26 to May 28
